## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals/financials showing multiple ABOVE TREND names. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology among top performers).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on momentum names: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY. Financials proving durable: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy soft: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate pressured: DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY; NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY; APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION; INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION; AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION; DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select industrials and chip-equipment names showing short-term pullbacks.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. Major divergence: multiple mega-cap techs in RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) — tactical momentum rather than confirmed trend shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive with rotation into select software/security names; PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 16/24 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy leadership within payments/banks: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION. Financials breadth: 14/20 positive (Sector Strength).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive and growth mix with broad participation: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare breadth: 13/17 positive (Sector Strength).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Healthcare exposure while selectively participating in high-momentum Tech (security/software) names; reduce exposure to lagging Utilities/Real Estate and to chip-equipment names showing exhaustion. Style: Mixed with a slight Value/Cyclical tilt given financials and cyclical strength; monitor tech RECOVERY names for confirmation before re-centering larger growth allocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — news-backed buyback/dividend (+85) could support. PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND despite recent supply-news (+60) — watch divergence. AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION and LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION for trend exhaustion.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (breadth 13/17 positive) and Financials (breadth 14/20 positive) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Utilities (3/10 positive) and Energy (3/10 positive) remain weak and at risk of further underperformance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
PANW break above recent highs would confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL hold of short-term rebound (1W strength) is critical to sustain RECOVERY; QCOM needs to reclaim recent pivot after the >10% 1W drop to avoid extended BELOW TREND action.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (+85): JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — $50B buyback/dividend headline confirms capital-return thesis and supports upside. QCOM (+60): QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — bullish data-center supply headline diverges from sharp price weakness, watch for distribution vs accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (-50): AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION — short bets and negative headlines align with this pullback, monitor for trend break. LRCX (-45): LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — sentiment negative and price weakening signals exhaustion. CEG (-45): CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND — price and sentiment both confirm downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a slight Value/Cyclical tilt. MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap techs in RECOVERY (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) represent a tactical divergence — watch for confirmation before expanding core growth exposure.
